description: Diff two EdgeGate runs in the same pipeline — metrics delta, gate flips (✓→✗ regressions and ✗→✓ recoveries), per-device breakdown, and an overall verdict (REGRESSION / IMPROVEMENT / NEUTRAL / NO BASELINE). When baseline_run_id is omitted, auto-selects the most recent PASSED run from the same pipeline as the baseline.

baseline_run_id.description: Baseline to compare against. When omitted, auto-selects the most recent PASSED run from the same pipeline (excluding the candidate itself), or the most recent completed run as a fallback.

name: edgegate_compare_runs
